name: Firestorm Brimorak
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-24: Breaking The Storm: Parting Clouds

defensiveAbilities.name: Boiling Blood
defensiveAbilities.description: Each time an adjacent creature deals slashing or piercing damage to the brimorak, the attacker is sprayed with the brimorak's boiling blood, which deals 3d4 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Extinguishing Aversion
defensiveAbilities.description: Dousing a brimorak with water, either ordinary water or from a water effect, causes no physical harm to the fiend but deals 3d6 Mental Damage damage. Fully immersing the brimorak in water deals 5d6 Mental Damage damage per round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
defensiveAbilities.description: Smoke doesn't impair a brimorak's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from smoke.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The brimorak spits their boiling blood in a 20ft Line that deals 8d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The brimorak can't use their Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

The ground within this area becomes slippery, with the effects of a Grease spell targeting an area until it's cleaned up or the brimorak is able to use their Breath Weapon again, whichever comes first.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flaming Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: A brimorak's hooves and any weapon they wield burst into flame, dealing an extra 1d6 Fire Damage damage with each hit. If they don't have a weapon, they can create a flaming sword of fire and steel (see flaming sword Strike in Melee entry above).

offensiveAbilities.name: Fume
offensiveAbilities.description: The brimorak emits a cloud of thick black smoke in a 10-foot burst that remains in place for 1d4 rounds. All creatures within the smoke become Concealed, and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within it. A creature that enters or begins its turn within the smoke it must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

cantrips.name: Produce Flame
cantrips.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and (@item.level)d4 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

lv4spells.name: Dispel Magic
lv4spells.targets: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item
lv4spells.description: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

lv4spells.name: Fireball
lv4spells.description:
A roaring blast of fire appears at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

lv5spells.name: Dimension Door
lv5spells.description:
Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

rituals.name: Abyssal Pact
rituals.description:
You call in a favor from another demon whose level is no more than double Abyssal pact's spell rank, two demons whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three demons whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are eager to pursue the task, so they don't ask for a favor.

Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are not eager to pursue the task, so they require a favor in return.

Failure You don't conjure any demons.

Critical Failure The demon or demons are angry that you disturbed them. They appear before you, but they immediately attack you.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a demon)
